one_line_definition: The engine core must remain valid locally without internet or external AI, and external connections must remain optional amplifiers rather than the body.

optional_amplifier.principle: Amplifiers may strengthen the core but must not replace it.

operating_rules: Core must continue even when external connectivity fails.
External results must enter as proposal/enrichment/support, not first truth.
State confirmation must happen only through local ledger plus layer transition.
External connections are boosters, not life-support.
design_tests: Does core lifecycle stop without this feature?
Does this feature confirm state or only enrich it?
Does it become meaningless when disconnected?
Does it record into ledger/layer or only emit output?
final_locks: The engine body must live locally.
External AI and internet are amplifiers, not the core.
Recording, state, and rereading must continue when connections fail.
External results are proposals to be reread by the local body.
Simple but strong scripts are a major strength of this engine.
